concepts.description: The model: resource -> action -> Action { paths, label? } -> Transition { from, to & { merge? } } -> Side { predicate, permission?, requires? }; map-qualified resource keys, action-level OR, from reads current / to reads merged record, imperative guards as from/to predicates
Can this change happen: checkTransition (first passing path wins), checkPath single-edge kernel, structured Reason/PathReason/SideReason, describe(), 403 vs 409 mapping

What can happen: available (from side, one record) and eligible compiling guards via toPrisma into a Prisma plan run with executePrismaPlan; predicate options now/timeZone/weekStart/bindings, map/mapName/model/lens, throws where uncompilable

What the package is not and does not yet do: stateless guard layer, no state machine/statecharts, side effects, workflow engine or config UI; requires loader, permission-filtered available, lens composition checks unbuilt

Who may do it: the injected Authorize callback and createAuthorize({ schema, map, isSuperadmin?, data? }) over @inixiative/permissions createRebacCheck; ActionRule forms, actor { model, record }, cycle denied
Decided rule: permission lives only on a side (from.permission AND to.permission, absent = open, null/false = deny), never on the action or edge; worked examples
How to.merge builds the merged record: applyMerge with spread (default), deepMerge, { kind: append | appendUnique, path }, or a callback
Transitions as pure data stored per tenant: isSerializable / isSerializableMerge (keyword merges yes, callbacks no), lens as field scope not authz, requires as metadata
validateTransition(t, { lens?, requireSerializable? }) on save: json-rules validateRule / validateRuleInLens, permissions validateActionRule, ValidationResult with codes, never throws
